commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a SQUARE 1:1 fantasy card illustration, no card border or typography, no symbols, no frame, no lock, no binding circle. Use the attached Veilbound card only for painting style: stylized 2D gouache, large angular masses, matte pigments, dark ink contours, selective angular highlights. Fantasy world with diverse cultures and a weathered lacquer, leather and bronze material language. No Greek or Roman costume motifs. Central subject must be immediately legible, large and fully inside the picture with breathing room on all sides. Keep environment subdued and darker than the subject, with strong edge separation and a simple, low-detail fantasy background. No photorealism.
